jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**What You'll Do

**This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

**Beyond That, You'll Bring

**

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

jobs.occupation: Lead Developer to support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced developer interested in building high-quality software and contributing to critical applications that support the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of the Nordic power grid? If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment, where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with two Lead Developers and five Senior Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC.

Your role

As a Lead Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative department of approximately 23 developers who design, develop and maintain the internal applications supporting our current and future business services. If you are curious about Nordic RCC and what we do, learn more about our innovative solutions on the Nordic RCC webpage.

Your role combines hands-on development with broader technical leadership. You will work closely with Application Architects to help define and communicate technical direction, translate architectural principles into practical solutions and promote consistency across our application landscape.

You will connect technical expertise across teams, identify shared challenges, and contribute to reusable, sustainable solutions. Through cross-departmental collaboration, you will build alignment around technical opportunities, constraints, and impacts across the organization.

What you will do :

• 
Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET, while promoting consistent standards, code quality, maintainability and operational stability

• 
Contribute to improving system architecture by identifying areas for technical refinement, refactoring, or modernization

• 
Collaborating across the organization, represent Application Development by collaborating with Product Owners, Delivery Management, testers, Quality Management and other departments

• 
Set and communicate technical direction with Application Architects, translating architectural principles and business needs into practical solutions and Architecture Decision Records

• 
Connect technical expertise across teams and applications, enabling collaboration on dependencies, common challenges and reusable solutions

• 
Support operational excellence by helping diagnose and resolve production issues and continuously optimize existing systems

• 
Share knowledge and technical expertise supporting colleagues’ professional development and help strengthen development practices across the team. This role does not include formal line-management responsibilities

Technology Stack:

• 
Primary languages and frameworks  C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python

• 
Architecture, design patterns & integrations  Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs

• 
Databases & storage Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3

• 
Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX

• 
Tooling and collaboration  Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines

We’re looking for someone with:

• 
Collaborative Attitude: You will be working closely with our team of Application Architects, shaping architectural decisions for supporting maintainable, scalable and robust systems

• 
Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

• 
Proven Expertise: Minimum 5 years’ experience as full-stack developer in C# for the .NET platform. Experience providing technical guidance, facilitating technical decisions, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating development activities is a definite plus.

• 
Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes

• 
Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling basis up until the right candidate has been found.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

jobs.description:
Lead the team. Grow the business. Shape what comes next.

Are you ready to lead commercial growth across a diverse and important healthcare customer segment? This is a visible leadership role where strategy, customer insight and an engaged sales team come together with real ownership of commercial performance and the future direction of the business.

At Mediq Denmark, you will lead a team of 8 sales professionals supporting GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals. You will work closely with the Sales Director to turn market insight into action, strengthen customer partnerships and identify the opportunities that can move the segment forward.

This is a role for a leader who enjoys being close to the market. One day you may be shaping the sales strategy or challenging a business case; the next, joining a strategic customer discussion, coaching a colleague or turning a new idea into a practical growth plan.

Your impact

You will set the direction for the segment and translate ambition into profitable, sustainable growth. With ownership of the sales budget, forecast and commercial performance, you will keep customer value, market opportunities and team development firmly in focus.

• Develop and execute the sales strategy for GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals, supported by clear segmentation, targeting and account plans.

• Strengthen relationships across the customer landscape, from individual practices to strategic private hospital accounts, and take an active role in key negotiations and customer meetings.

• Use customer, market and competitor insight to identify growth opportunities, shape go-to-market plans and guide pricing and commercial decisions.

• Lead, coach and develop eight sales professionals, creating clear priorities, accountability and the confidence to perform at their best.

• Connect Sales with Category, Product Management and Sourcing to align the assortment, supplier strategy and commercial priorities around a strong customer experience.

What you bring

We are looking for a commercially curious and customer-focused sales leader who sees the bigger picture, acts with pace and brings people with them. You are comfortable moving between strategic business development and hands-on sales leadership, and you know when to explore the detail and when to step back and set direction.

• At least five years of documented experience in a comparable commercial and leadership role, including leading, coaching and developing sales professionals.

• A strong track record in sales execution, performance management and working with sales processes at both operational and strategic level.

• Strong commercial and analytical judgement, including the ability to develop and assess business cases and make sound pricing and growth decisions.

• Confident negotiation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, supported by a structured and pragmatic approach to projects and processes.

• High energy, clear ownership and the ability to prioritise in a fast-paced and complex environment.

• Fluency in Danish and English. Experience from MedTech or the healthcare sector is an advantage.

Why join Mediq?

You will join a role where sales leadership is close to the action and your decisions will be visible. You will have the opportunity to influence commercial direction, build stronger customer partnerships and develop a team that can take this customer segment into its next chapter.

Our values - Customer Drive, Champion Spirit and Caring Heart - guide how we work, with a constant focus on creating value for patients.

Ready to lead the next stage of growth?

Bring your commercial leadership, customer focus and energy to Mediq. Help us strengthen the business, develop our people and build what comes next for customers across Denmark.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark.

Interested?

Submit your application through CareersatMediq.com or contact Artjoms.Bikovskis@Mediq.com, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics and Baltics. We review every application with care and look forward to learning what you could bring to the future of Mediq Denmark.

We will be reviewing applications and interviewing candidates on a rolling basis as suitable candidates are identified. For this reason, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

About Mediq

Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics and home care, we help ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

At Mediq, we offer jobs that change lives. Join us.

Are you a people-focused leader who thrives on guiding teams toward shared goals? We’re looking for a supervisor who can inspire and develop a team while ensuring effective collaboration and results. In this role, you’ll play a key part in turning strategy into action and creating an environment where people and performance grow together.

You will be responsible for one of our production areas, where we make the blades ready for painting. Here you will be responsible for around 20 - 30 employees, hourly paid production workers. In cooperation with the Production Manager and Supervisor colleagues you ensure that production is delivered safely, of the right quality according to delivery plan. Secure that the team is delivering according to the agreed production plan in its own process area.

In Nakskov, the production working schedule is based on a 3-1-3-7 rotation of 12-hour shifts. That means that you will meet on Thursday, Friday and Saturday with a day off on Sunday. Then return to work Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday before going off for a week. It will be permanent night- or dayshift.

• Secure deliveries to the specified quality criteria and according to the production requirements and resources

• Ensure efficient and high performing team with 5S as foundation

• Secure that the employees are being trained according to the production training development program

• Maintain correct use of production planning software/hardware

• Continuous motivation and leadership development

Competencies

• You thrive in an organization in continuous development

• You work with ease across different cultures

• You have solid experience of people management in a manufacturing environment e.g. in a chemical or with mechanical processes

• Good understanding and experience with Six-sigma and 5S

• Confident user of Microsoft Office and general good IT skills

What we offer

An exciting and complex role in a global renewable energy company, with opportunities for professional and personal growth. You will help shape a critical area within Vestas and be part of an international, collaborative team.

jobs.occupation: Excellence & Engagement Manager - Health, Safety & Security
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of a global team that works passionately every day to ensure employees at DFDS go to work for DFDS and return safely and unharmed home to their loved ones? If this excites you then look no further and come join us.

About The Role  Be part of the movement - and play your part.   As Excellence & Engagement Manager in the Global Health, Safety & Security Team, you will be part of the continuous strengthening of DFDS’ health, safety and security culture. This is a new global role, and we expect you to participate in shaping and developing it. We anticipate that you will contribute by developing, implementing and continuously improving the frameworks, standards, tools, learning processes, communications and engagement activities that enable a strong Health, Safety & Security (HSS) performance across DFDS landside operations.

You will be responsible for ensuring consistent and effective deployment of group-wide HSS initiatives across DFDS operations area, supporting operational teams in anchoring safe and secure behaviors. The role works closely with the HSS Business Partners, other operational stakeholders and senior management to strengthen organizational learning, capability, culture and performance.

The role reports directly to the Global Director for HSS, and you will be based at our Global Headquarters in the port of Copenhagen. The role requires on-site presence.

What kind of exciting challenges can you expect to meet in this role?:  **Role

**As Excellence & Engagement Manager - HSS you will get the opportunity to influence and develop the role but the initial areas we expect you to cover are:

• Develop, coordinate and monitor global HSS initiatives.

• Develop, coordinate and maintain global HSS culture-building activities, campaigns and engagement programs aiming to strengthen safe and secure behaviors.

• Maintain and continuously improve our HSSEQ Management System.

• Develop, implement and continuously improve a Managers Toolkit on HSS.

• Manage Performance Monitoring and Improvement related to HSS in close collaboration with HSS Business Partners.

• Develop and coordinate DFDS’ organizational learning processes on HSS, ensuring learnings from incidents, audits etc. are translated into practical improvements and shared across the organization.

• Support leadership teams in understanding and applying HSS frameworks, standards and improvement methodologies.

• Build strong working relationships with operational leaders, local HSS teams, and functional stakeholders.

About You We think that the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we think that you are passionate about health, safety & security, have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, are a good listener and can digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

You Are Structured, Self-supporting And Capable Of Both Prioritizing And Multitasking In a Demanding Environment. Moreover, We Imagine That The Ideal Candidate Brings

• Ability to think strategically, translating HSS strategy into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

• A passion for building a strong HSS culture through engagement, communication and leadership influence.

• Experience in developing and implementing standards, frameworks and management systems within operational environments.

• Natural collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence without direct authority.

• Strong organizing skills, bringing structure, governance and consistency to complex initiatives.

• Capability to operate between strategy and execution, balancing long-term objectives with day-to-day deliveries, in a global corporate function.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, good listening abilities, and the ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

• A self-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize and multitask in a demanding environment.

**Furthermore, You Have

**

• A degree in business, organizational development, safety or security management, or related field.

• Proven experience (5+ years) within safety or security related functions in a global or matrixed organization.

• Experience in shipping, logistics, or industrial sectors is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of safety/security culture principles and organizational behavior is an advantage.

• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Knowledge of or certification in change management methodologies is a plus.

• Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is an advantage.

• Proficiency in English (oral and written) as English is corporate language.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 suite.

• Experience in utilizing AI tools is an advantage.

Working at DFDS  Join the movement and grow with us.  While you’re with us, we want you to develop and move yourself on. We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself to acquire new skills and perspectives.

At DFDS, we promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.   If you think your personality, skills, experience and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your resume as soon as possible as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

Is there something you need to know, we haven’t covered here, please do not hesitate to reach out to Global Director HSS (Landside) Steffen Conradsen on sconr@dfds.com.

Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the autumn holiday period and business travel activities within the hiring team, however, rest assured that we will get back to you at earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you.   This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

Requirements

Experience

> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Technical Skills

> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

Operating Skills

> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

Benefits

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we’re happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

Usercentrics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Do you want to shape the engineering direction behind technology that drives the energy sector?

At Mind Energy, technology enables how we trade, optimise and evolve in a fast-moving energy market. As our Senior Software Engineer, you take a central role in building and evolving the digital backbone that supports critical business decisions every day.

You combine strong technical depth with architectural thinking and a hands-on engineering mindset. Working closely with experienced colleagues across development and business, you help shape scalable systems, influence technical direction and raise the engineering bar around you.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

In this role, you take an active par t in shaping the technical direction of our digital landscape. You modernise existing systems, build new solutions and turn complexity into reliable, scalable software that supports both trading and long-term growth.

Your mission is to:

• Design, develop, test and deploy stable, scalable and secure software solutions

• Take architectural responsibility and influence the long-term direction of our digital platform

• Build resilient services and systems designed for performance, scalability and maintainability

• Drive technical improvements and challenge existing solutions with a strong engineering mindset

• Collaborate closely across teams while supporting knowledge sharing, sparring and engineering quality

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

You’ll join an autonomous, cross-functional team with end-to-end ownership of its domain, spanning design, architecture, implementation and operations.

Together, you work closely with business stakeholders to translate complex needs into robust, scalable and secure solutions that create real value for our customers.

At Mind Energy, we value both independence and collaboration.

Your work ranges from refining existing systems to shaping entirely new solutions, always with a clear sense of ownership and responsibility. You approach complexity with curiosity and turn challenges into solutions built to last.

LET’S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You are an experienced engineer who thrives with ownership, technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence how solutions are designed and built. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, architectural understanding and the confidence to challenge decisions when better

solutions exist.

We imagine that you bring:

• Extensive experience building scalable systems in C# and .NET, with a consistent approach to clean, maintainable code and modern design patterns

• Hands-on experience designing and building resilient, event-driven services in distributed and cloud-native environments

• Experience balancing scalability, reliability and maintainability when designing architectures for complex production systems

• Experience taking technical ownership and helping shape engineering direction through architectural decisions, sparring and pragmatic technical leadership

If you also have insight into the energy sector, it will be an advantage, but it is not required.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply, as we believe that a diverse team leads to innovation and success.

Please note that this role requires working from our office location Aarhus N.

WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE

People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional “Just Because” surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year.

Through Mind Club, people come together around everything from padel and Football Shirt Fridays to clay pigeon shooting and Christmas afternoons with your family and Santa. And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It’s easier to experience in person.

We’re mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognising that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more.

LET US GET THIS CONVERSATION STARTED

If this sounds like the right fit for you - do not wait - send your resume as soon as you can, and no later than November 6, 2026.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Got questions or need more details? Reach out to Tony Frydensberg, Director, Head of IT Development at: tofr@mindenergy.com.

For general questions reach out to people@mindenergy.com

What if your code shaped the future of energy?

Energy is changing. Fast. And at Mind Energy, we’re right at the epicentre of it all.

For decades, we have led the way in European energy trading - impatiently pushing forward, turning our deep market knowledge into reliable solutions and trading strategies. Today, we trade across more than 40 markets. But it’s how we work that defines us: with curiosity, care and a mindset of “what if”. We listen, share, and push ideas forward - together.

Here, people matter, and we grow as specialists and as teammates. We bring many kinds of intelligence into play – from sharp thinking to smart models. That’s what makes us energy minds.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**Group IT keeps SimCorp running. The same discipline we bring to our clients' investment operations is applied to our own enterprise platforms. Workday and Salesforce are at the center of how we manage our people and client relationships.

As Senior Director, Enterprise Applications, you will own the strategy, governance, and operational health of Workday and Salesforce across the organization. You will serve as the primary accountable leader for these platforms, partnering closely with business functions to ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations through your leadership team and subject matter experts.

This is a senior leadership position with high visibility across Group IT, P&C, and Sales, providing direct influence over the evolution of two of SimCorp's most business-critical enterprise platforms.

You will step directly into a strategic and business-critical transformation initiative: the migration of financial processes and data from Workday to SAP S/4HANA, with a planned go-live in January 2027. Success in this role requires the ability to quickly engage in data mapping, integration planning, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution from day one.

**The organization consists of:

**

• 5 individual contributors reporting directly to the role

• 2 managers reporting directly to the role

• 29 employees in total across the Enterprise Applications area

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Define and own the multi-year strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Workday and Salesforce, aligning platform capabilities and investments with business priorities and growth objectives

• Establish and chair platform governance forums with P&C, Sales, Customer Success, and other key stakeholders to prioritize enhancements, integrations, releases, and investment decisions

• Ensure the stability, performance, security, and availability of Workday and Salesforce through effective release management, testing, monitoring, and change control practices

• Oversee the end-to-end integration landscape across Workday, Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA

• Manage strategic relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including contracts, licensing, and commercial oversight in partnership with Software Asset Management

• Own platform security and access governance, including role design, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews, and compliance with internal control requirements

• Partner closely with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, and Internal Audit teams to ensure effective controls, timely remediation activities, and adherence to GDPR and other regulatory requirements

• Drive continuous improvement and adoption of platform capabilities to increase business value, operational efficiency, and user experience across the organization

**What We Value

**

• 10+ years of leadership experience in enterprise applications, with deep expertise in Workday and Salesforce, or solid hands-on experience in one platform combined with demonstrated leadership responsibility for the other

• 5+ years of people management experience leading teams of platform owners, administrators, business analysts, or related application specialists

• A proven track record of establishing and operating governance models for enterprise platforms in a global, regulated, or financial services environment

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration architectures.

• Experience managing SaaS vendors, software licensing, commercial agreements, and strategic partner relationships

• Solid knowledge of data privacy, risk, and security frameworks, including GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001

• Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at both executive and technical levels

• Workday and/or Salesforce certifications are considered an advantage

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we provide custom paths for professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**For Poland Location

**Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement.

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp: www.simcorp.com/career

**Next steps

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

**Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.
